entries.title: Keep a sign-in available when switching Settings tabs
entries.body: A sign-in on another computer keeps its code, prompt and Cancel when you return to Settings. If that computer reconnects, the interrupted sign-in ends so you can start again. When the first mate needs an update, your account and project-host rows stay available; only sign-in starts are disabled.
entries.noPicture: The primary fix is recovery across tab switches and reconnects, which needs a recording; existing account-management rows keep their usual appearance.
